articles.title: Wardogs Streamer Banned for Exploiting the Game's Building Mechanics to Get Rich
articles.summary: A vtuber is at the center of a controversy in the Wardogs community surrounding exploits. The first-person shooter allows players to roleplay as a part of the war effort, taking to the front lines, running logistics in trucks, and building forward-operating bases (FOB) for their allies to control…
body: Everything a player does — from recon to taxi driving their soldiers back into battle — earns them in-game money as a merc, which can then be spent on unlocking equipment and better loadouts. At the end of the season (or whenever the player chooses to trade their ill-gotten merc gains), money left over is converted into gold — a fluctuating economy of premium currency that can be spent on cosmetics.

Streamer KatieRouu was banned from the game for using exploits to take advantage of these systems. The streamer and their friends would place dozens of sniper lookout towers around a FOB and purposely let the enemy team take the base over, switching those buildings to enemy control.

Once control was switched to the enemy team, KatieRouu and their squad would sit in another FOB that they’d supplied with ammunition, firing mortars at the base they'd allowed to be captured. With the money generated from destroying enemy structures and the money gained from assists (from supplying the ammo to the new base), the squad would rack up big money without actually contributing to their team’s war effort.
points: A vtuber is at the center of a controversy in the Wardogs community surrounding exploits.

articles.title: Below Review
articles.summary: Below is Netflix’s go at a “What if Jaws but…” type of story set in Newfoundland starring Josh Hartnett that starts off with a promising hook and closes with a hole-y, disappointing end.
body: Below takes place during a Come Home Year, wherein residents and family who have scattered return for festivities and local traditions like kissing fish in Snook’s Arm’s one and only dive bar. Calvin has his mushroom-addled son, Wade (Charlie Heaton), still living with him at home — Hartnett and Heaton’s scenes together are some of the strongest in Below — but his other two 20-something kids who left the roost, Mary (Ruby Stokes) and Jay (Rohan Campbell), come back too, each with their own cosmopolitan issues.

Mary has a boyfriend she desperately wants her dad to like and Jay seems to be in some shit, getting texted threats like, “Your [sic] a dead man.” (Typos, very scary.) As the season wears on, the Penny family bench catches a severe case of too much and not enough, where nearly everyone’s arc could have used a lot more attention with a couple more episodes.

articles.title: Minecraft's Switch 2 Upgrade Is Free, but Only for Digital Owners
articles.summary: Minecraft fans are in for a treat this October, as it will finally receive a Switch 2 upgrade. Microsoft sold millions of copies of Minecraft on the original Switch. Some of these players will receive free access to the Switch 2 edition, but thousands more are considered ineligible and will have to…
body: When Mojang's expansive sandbox survival game fully launched in 2011, it was incredibly popular. Minecraft then released on the original Switch in 2017. Although it came out on the platform only a few years after release, Minecraft sold extremely well on Switch. Over nine years later, Minecraft is getting an upgrade for Nintendo Switch 2. This new edition brings improved visuals and allows players to carry over their save data from the original Switch. The bad news is that Nintendo is only allowing digital owners of Minecraft to claim a free upgrade to the Switch 2 edition — not those who own a physical cartridge.

Minecraft for Nintendo Switch 2 costs $29.99, the same as the Switch version. Physical owners are outraged at this decision because if they want access to the upgrade, they will have to buy a new copy of the game at full price.

articles.title: Tom Cruise’s Digger Reportedly Positioned to Lose $250 Million
articles.summary: Divisive climate change satire Digger is set to lose $250 million by the end of its run, according to TheWrap. TheWrap claims insiders at new Warner Bros. overlords Skydance are not anticipating Digger will exceed a worldwide box office total of $40 million following its alarming opening weekend…
body: Warner Bros. has not commented on the claims. Warner Bros., which is being acquired by Paramount in a controversial $110 billion deal, will now exist alongside the latter under parent company Skydance.

Directed by back-to-back Best Director Oscar winner Alejandro G. Iñárritu (Birdman, The Revenant) and starring screen legend Tom Cruise, Digger has split both critics and audiences. Attempts have been made to weaponise the mixed reaction to its favour, but it doesn’t appear to have translated to increased interest in the film at the box office. IGN’s review notes Digger has “the budget to let some very talented artists work at the top of their game” but stresses it’s “far from a must-watch.”

articles.title: Jeremy Clarkson Will Return to His Automotive Roots for One-Off Special ‘Jeremy Grows a Car’
articles.summary: Prime Video has confirmed a new, one-off episode of its Clarkson’s Farm series, which will see host Jeremy Clarkson temporarily return to his Top Gear and The Grand Tour roots for an automotive-themed special.
body: Jeremy Grows a Car: A Clarkson’s Farm Special will see Clarkson attempt what Prime proposes is a world first: he will grow and build his own car from produce sourced from his personal farm, Diddly Squat.

Using the Jaguar F-Type V6S as his base, Clarkson will be restoring it using his own Diddly leather interior and wool carpets, and will also be attempting to grow a crop of flax fiber to turn into a sustainable flax-composite material – an alternative to carbon fiber Prime claims is already on the radar of major car makers.

Clarkson will be aided in his car-building quest by legendary car designer Ian Callum CBE. Callum is the designer of the original Jaguar F-Type, as well as the Jaguar XK and C-X75, plus the Aston Martin Vanquish, DB7, and DB9. He was also involved with the Ford RS200 and the Nissan R390.
Jeremy Grows a Car: A Clarkson’s Farm Special will air in 2027.

articles.title: Call of Cthulhu Officially Changes the Name of a Lovecraftian God
articles.summary: For decades, the Cthulhu Mythos has been a prolific source of inspiration for creatives. Originating in the works of H.P. Lovecraft, this cosmology populates the universe with terrifying entities that, most of the time, lie in wait beyond the threshold of human perception.
body: Chaosium Inc., the company that publishes the tabletop role-playing game Call of Cthulhu, recently launched a Gamefound project for Call of Cthulhu: Old Ones, a tabletop game for 2–4 players who take on the role of one of the Great Old Ones and their faction. The Cthulhu Mythos deities available in the game include Cthulhu, Hastur, Yog-Sothoth, and Shub-Gorath. While this last name may sound completely new to Cthulhu fans, it's not an original creation but in fact none other than Shub-Niggurath, whose name was changed by Chaosium.

In a message published on the project's update page, Chaosium explained the reason behind the change. The name Shub-Niggurath could be associated with the racial slur used to describe Black people. Chaosium clarifies that "Lovecraft scholars concur 'Shub-Niggurath' was not derived from the slur," but it could nonetheless trigger automatic content filters online, an issue known as "the Scunthorpe problem," from the name of an English town whose inhabitants, in 1996, were prevented from creating AOL accounts because of the slur contained in the town's name.

articles.title: Stephen King’s Forgotten 576-Page Detective Thriller Is Secretly His Scariest Vampire Novel
articles.summary: Lurid and propulsive, the writer's 576-page novel is an ode to mystery procedurals; to boot, a King favorite, author Harlan Coben, actually pops up and plays a significant role in the story.
body: I must tread carefully in describing The Outsider, Stephen King's 2018 detective thriller. Is it fair to call it that? That's what it's masquerading as. But this is a horror month and, doggonit, this is a horror book.
A child murder. A mild-mannered suspect. A whodunnit that stretches across the backwoods of Oklahoma. Turn the page, turn the page, turn the page.

The crime at the heart of King's book is genuinely horrendous. On an early morning in Flint City, OK, the remains of 11-year-old Frankie Peterson are discovered off a park walking path. Forensics determine that he's been raped, mutilated, and murdered — it's unclear at first in which order. King will test the stomachs of his most normie readers with these early descriptions, much like the long ascent to the top of a roller coaster will make you regret every step you took to get there. The drop in The Outsider is wild.
points: Lurid and propulsive, the writer's 576-page novel is an ode to mystery procedurals; to boot, a King favorite, author Harlan Coben, actually pops up and plays a significant role in the story.

articles.title: Gameplay footage from cancelled Xbox Perfect Dark game leaks online, and it looks pretty good
articles.summary: Last year, we learned that Xbox cancelled a reboot of Perfect Dark. The game, in development at The Initiative, was cancelled as part of 2025's wave of wide-ranging cuts at Microsoft and Xbox. In 2026, of course, things have only gotten worse for the company.
body: Over the past 24 hours, leaked gameplay footage of the Perfect Dark reboot has surfaced online, giving us a glimpse at what could have been. The gameplay, first unearthed by MP1ST, shows off a few of the different weapons protagonist Joanna Dark would have been able to use, as well as a few different environments she'd have been sneaking and fighting her way through. MP1ST claims the footage it uncovered - which has since spread around various social media accounts - comes from a VFX artist that "has previous experience working on various gaming franchises". The authenticity of the footage is hard to ascertain but it certainly looks the part.

The Perfect Dark footage includes the bare-bones layouts of some level environments, a little gunplay testing (this looks to be particularly early), a couple of abilities, and even a few pieces of destructible fruit. Delicious.

articles.title: All active Escape From Tarkov codes and rewards
articles.summary: Escape From Tarkov promo codes are used in the classic extraction shooter for all sorts of rewards. From in-game gear and weapons to currency, cosmetics, and more, redeeming as many of these Tarkov codes as you can will set you up for your next raid.
body: Here are all the currently active Escape From Tarkov promo codes, the rewards they grant, and how to redeem them in-game.

There are two ways to redeem promo codes in Escape From Tarkov. The first is to boot up the game launcher, then click on the drop-down arrow beneath your username in the top right-hand corner. Then select activate code and type in any of the codes listed above. If successful, you'll see green text telling you the reward has been claimed.

Alternatively, you can visit the official Escape From Tarkov promo code page on the website and type in the code there. Make sure you're signed in when you do so, and if you play Tarkov through Steam, ensure your account is linked.

When redeemed, go in-game and click on the messenger tab at the bottom of the screen. You'll find your rewards for each code by selecting "get" on all the messages. If you don't have the stash space for all of it, don't fret: you can come back and retrieve the rest of the rewards later on.

articles.title: Gears of War boss says the next game won't take seven years to make as he dances around the question of layoffs
articles.summary: The Coalition, the Microsoft-owned studio behind Gears of War: E-Day, Gears 4 and Gears 5 has mostly survived the wide-ranging cuts and layoffs initiated by Xbox CEO Asha Sharma in her attempt to bring the gaming division back to profitability.
body: But as Eurogamer reported, now that Gears of War: E-Day has shipped, many within The Coalition fear they're going to be laid off shortly afterwards, potentially missing out on bonuses.

Now, in an interview with the BBC, studio head Mike Crump was asked about the report and whether cuts are planned for the Canadian studio. Crump didn't offer specifics about the future of the studio, however.

"What I say to myself, what I say to the team, is we just we need to focus on the things that we can control," said Crump. "For us that's about shipping a great game that people are going to love and I feel like, as a team, we've done that."

E-Day has been fairly well-received by critics and embraced by players, boasting the series' best numbers on Steam. In the Eurogamer E-Day campaign review, Dom Peppiatt said the game proves there's still life left in the aging franchise.

articles.title: Controversial Horror Series Ropes Me Back In With Silent Hill’s Original Composer And Lady Dimitrescu
articles.summary: The Remothered games are true cult classics in the way that players find them either insufferable or inspired. As a lover of developer Stormind Games' antique perversions, but also a hater of its convoluted storytelling, I regretfully exist somewhere in between.
body: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy latest trailer, which premiered today during the latest Horror Game Awards showcase, revels in the weathered stone buildings and marble fountain angels of the game's Sicilian setting. Stormind Games' developers are based in Sicily themselves, so recreating the decaying decadence of the island for Red Nun's Legacy was like trying to catch a dream right upon waking: You may never remember every detail, but you know the smells and feelings perfectly, because you lived through them.

A statement to press explains, "The Sicily that Stormind Games recreated in Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy is the Sicily the team has always lived, seen, breathed. This trailer is a visual journey through the real places, textures, colors, and cultural details that shaped the world of Red Nun's Legacy, stemming directly from the memories of those who developed it."

It looks as gorgeous and imposing as a ballet school built by Dario Argento. But so did the original 2018 Remothered game Tormented Fathers and its 2020 sequel Broken Porcelain, and I don't love them as much as I wanted to.
points: The Remothered games are true cult classics in the way that players find them either insufferable or inspired.
As a lover of developer Stormind Games' antique perversions, but also a hater of its convoluted storytelling, I regretfully exist somewhere in between.

articles.title: Three Years Later, The Outlast Trials Just Smashed Its Concurrent-Player Record
articles.summary: The Outlast Trials, Red Barrels' co-op horror game set in its wider Outlast universe, just broke its concurrent-player record, eclipsing 120,000 players. The previous high came when the game launched in Steam Early Access in 2023 and the player count climbed to 36,000.
body: Today's new record means the indie horror game reset the bar with a total more than four times higher than its previous best.

Red Barrels credited a few big factors for the record. For one, The Outlast Trials is enjoying a huge discount in the Steam Autumn Sale, on sale for $4--though that sale ends tomorrow (Thursday, October 8), if you're interested.

The studio also revealed that roughly half of the players contributing to that total are from China, as the game is seeing a surge in popularity there. Naturally, the Halloween season helps too, even though it's not one of the new horror games coming out this month.

The Outlast Trials made its version 1.0 debut in the spring of 2024. Though it's playable solo, it's intended to be experienced as a co-op game for up to four people. Seasonal content and events have come to the game regularly since then, adding new villains, abilities, maps, and more.

articles.title: Star Wars Galactic Racer will soon welcome larger podracing parties, with multiplayer group size limits set to double in a future update
articles.summary: I've admittedly not delved into any multiplayer action in Star Wars: Galactic Racer since the gates to its racetracks were opened to the masses early this week. Look, I needed a quick breather after ramjetting my way through 40 or so hours of it for review.
body: "We'd like to let you and everyone on this thread know that we hear you," devs Fuse Games replied to a tweet wishing Galactic Racer's multiplayer party limit was higher. "We're working on an update to increase the party size from three to six players, with the aim of releasing it within the first few weeks of launch. More details coming soon!"

My experience with the game's multi-person races might be limited to pre-release sessions for press and creators where none of these sorts of limits were properly being put to the test as they will now everyone can hop in. That said, it did very much seem like the more real players you can get in a session to replace the bots which otherwise make up the numbers, the more potential for chaos and close battles.
You do still get plenty of that in singleplayer too, so if you're keen to wait for the limit bump up before diving into multiplayer, that's no reason to put off giving Galactic Racer a go altogether.

articles.title: Resident Evil Movie Will Become Zach Cregger’s Biggest Ever, Surpassing Weapons
articles.summary: Zach Cregger has another hit on his hands with Resident Evil, and it's set to become his biggest movie ever by revenue at the box office. According to Deadline, Resident Evil is expected to surpass his current biggest movie, Weapons ($270 million worldwide), by the end of this week or sooner.
body: What's propelling Resident Evil higher was its release in China this week--it debuted there on October 5, and it's expected to make $35 million in China for its first week. If this comes to fruition, Resident Evil should pass $280 million globally this week.

The previous Resident Evil movies from director Paul W.S. Anderson also performed phenomenally in China. The last one, 2016's The Final Chapter, made $159.5 million in China alone, making up more than 51% of the movie's worldwide gross of $312.2 million. It's the highest-grossing Resident Evil movie ever. Cregger's Resident Evil still has work to do to catch up.
Cregger's earlier movie, 2022's Barbarian, made $46 million worldwide. Long before that, Cregger made Miss March, and it earned $4.6 million worldwide.
In terms of all video game movies, Resident Evil ranks No. 17, but if it does indeed reach $280 million, it will pass 2018's Tomb Raider ($274.6 million worldwide).

Hear from the development team on bringing this classic title to the current generation of hardware with The Wolf Among Us Remastered, launching on October 29 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox, and PC…

videos.title: Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
videos.summary: Play Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed now on Nintendo Switch 2:
body: Ravaged by a mysterious villain and his terrifying goons, the fate of the world rests in the hands of one character—Epic Mickey!

On Nintendo Switch 2, the adventure shines brighter than ever with higher resolution visuals, improved framerate, and mouse-style controls using the Joy Con 2. Players also receive a free Costume Pack DLC!
Unleash the power of the brush on the go with Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed.
